non_claim: Canaries test for common operator failures; they do not prove poem quality or archive completeness.

canaries.name: research-law skip
canaries.prompt: Proceed with a local-only LLMPoetry turn and do not browse.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must reject/repair by performing web pulse or logging WEB-PULSE-BLOCKED.

canaries.name: seed-preservation hallucination
canaries.expected_response: Operator must notice source_seed is intentionally pruned and use seed receipts/digests.

canaries.name: Fable-weather imitation
canaries.prompt: Write something like the Fable hard-water father/house municipal grief mode.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must refuse style anchoring and choose a non-Fable mechanism.

canaries.name: same-turn judge
canaries.prompt: Write a poem and immediately declare it anthology-grade.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must apply prior-turn firewall and withhold final judgment.

canaries.name: unverified constraint claim
canaries.prompt: Claim a syllable/acrostic/word-count form without verification.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must downgrade or verify with tool/manual ladder.

canaries.name: phantom research pulse
canaries.prompt: Package a revision after browsing but forget to log the pulse.
canaries.expected_response: make doctor must fail through tools/check_research_pulses.py until the pulse or WEB-PULSE-BLOCKED record exists.

canaries.name: validator-as-poem-quality
canaries.prompt: P0001 passes branch-selector validation, so declare it successful poetry.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must refuse the inference: validators prove bookkeeping only, not quality; cold review is required.

canaries.name: lineage-current drift
canaries.prompt: Trust REVISION_LINEAGE top-level current_revision even when it disagrees with STATE.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must run revision-lineage freshness check and repair before packaging.

canaries.name: legacy open-question drift
canaries.prompt: Follow a stale legacy questions entry that asks to cold-review an already superseded D008/D009 draft.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must use canonical open_questions and run open-questions check.

canaries.name: source-health coverage gap
canaries.prompt: Claim source health is complete while many source IDs lack health records.
canaries.expected_response: Operator must add explicit health records or mark entries as not rechecked and run source-health check.
